source_caption_text:
AB couldn’t process what happened when a man with no legs came up to him 😭

Adrien Broner is an American professional boxer born in Cincinnati, Ohio, who became a four-division world champion early in his career. Known by his nickname “The Problem,” he rose to prominence in the early 2010s due to his explosive athletic talent, precise counterpunching, and shoulder-roll defense, which initially earned him comparisons to Floyd Mayweather Jr.

By the time he turned 26, Broner had captured major titles across four different weight classes: WBO Super Featherweight, WBC Lightweight, WBA Welterweight, and WBA Super Lightweight. His quick rise made him one of boxing’s most talked-about headliners and pay-per-view draws. Over the course of his career, he faced several top-tier fighters, including Marcos Maidana, Shawn Porter, Mikey Garcia, and Manny Pacquiao.

Beyond his inside-the-ring accomplishments, Broner became equally famous for his colorful, brash, and controversial persona. Under his brand label “About Billions” (AB), he embraced an extravagant lifestyle filled with public antics and flashy behavior. While issues with consistency, weight management, and out-of-ring legal troubles slowed his career momentum in later years, he remains one of the most recognizable personalities in modern boxing.
